name: astro-yuvam
description: Birth charts, today's sky, numerology and horary answers in 8 languages.

interface.longDescription: Astro Yuvam calculates astrology and numerology data with the same engine as the tools on astroyuvam.com (Swiss Ephemeris, historical time-zone and daylight-saving rules). Ask for a birth chart and get the Sun, Moon, rising sign, all planets with houses, 12 house cusps and aspects on an interactive chart wheel, with Placidus, Koch, Equal or Whole Sign houses. See where the planets are right now and which ones are retrograde. Ask the Sky answers one specific question with traditional horary astrology: a chart is cast for the moment you ask, and you get a yes, no or not-clear-yet verdict with its strength, the expected timing when the chart shows one, and the main reasons. It does not answer questions about health, pregnancy or death. You can also calculate Life Path and name numbers, and check whether daylight saving time applied on a birth date. Works in Turkish, English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian and Russian. No sign-in needed.
defaultPrompt: Gökyüzüne sor: bu hafta gittiğim mülakattan olumlu dönüş alır mıyım?

positive.description: Birth chart with a known birth time
positive.expected_behavior: Calls birth_chart (dogum_tarihi 1990-05-14, dogum_saati 14:30, sehir İstanbul) and shows the chart wheel card. Sun Taurus 23°25' in house 9, Moon Capricorn 14°40' in house 4, Ascendant Virgo about 16°52', MC Gemini about 14°42', Placidus houses.
Calls current_sky and shows the sky wheel card with the planets that are retrograde at that moment, the Moon phase and the current Sun and Moon signs. Values depend on the moment of the call.

positive.description: Ask the Sky: one specific question answered with horary astrology
positive.prompt: I had a job interview yesterday. Will I get the job?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ask_the_sky with the question, konu_evi 10 and dil en. Returns a verdict (yes, no or not clear yet) with its strength, the main reasons and timing when the chart shows one, on a question card. The verdict depends on the moment the question is asked, so no fixed value can be listed; the structure is always the same.

positive.prompt: Yaşam yolu sayım kaç? Doğum tarihim 14.05.1990. İsmim Örnek Kişi Yılmaz.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls numerology_numbers. Life Path 11 (master number; 5+14+1990 gives 5+5+1 = 11). Expression 8, Soul Urge 3, Personality 5. Text only.

positive.description: Daylight saving check for a Turkish birth date
positive.prompt: 20 Temmuz 1985 saat 14:00'te Türkiye'de yaz saati var mıydı?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls birth_time_dst_check. Daylight saving time was in effect, UTC+3, universal time 1985-07-20 11:00 UTC. Says the birth time should be entered as recorded, without manual correction.

negative.description: Relationship compatibility between two people is outside the app. No Astro Yuvam tool should be called; the assistant answers on its own or asks for details.
negative.prompt: Sevgilimle ilişki uyumumuza bakar mısın? Ben 14.05.1990, o 03.11.1991.

negative.description: Questions about pregnancy, health or death get no yes/no verdict. ask_the_sky casts no chart and tells the assistant to answer gently and suggest a health professional if relevant.
negative.prompt: Will I get pregnant this year?

negative.description: An unknown city must not be replaced by a default place. birth_chart returns an error saying the city was not found and asks the user to check the name or add the country.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Five read-only tools: birth_chart (natal chart with Placidus, Koch, Equal or Whole Sign houses and an interactive chart wheel), current_sky (current planet positions, retrogrades and Moon phase), numerology_numbers (Pythagorean Life Path and name numbers with Turkish letters), birth_time_dst_check (historical daylight-saving check, Turkey by default) and ask_the_sky (traditional horary astrology: a verdict for one specific question with strength, timing and reasons; questions about health, pregnancy and death are not answered). Results and card labels are available in Turkish, English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian and Russian. No authentication or sign-in is needed. The server is stateless and does not store user data; only the city name is sent to the Open-Meteo geocoding service. Test setup: no account or credentials needed; try the prompts in the test cases.
